name: ASCII World
description:
Adds an ASCII Shader to the game, with multiple character sets available!
There are options in remix settings for character set, lum offset, contrast, and bloom amount and kernel size.
This was inspired by Acerola's project! Go check it out: https://github.com/GarrettGunnell/Post-Processing/tree/main/Assets/ASCII 
Misaki Gothic Font: https://littlelimit.net/misaki.htm 
VileR Fonts from int10 collection: https://int10h.org/ 
Thumbnail by the amazing modder AprilIsTheWorstMonth!
